title: The Planets Gather for a Show in the Evening Sky (2/2)
titleZh: 行星齊聚夜空上演天文秀 (2/2)
summaryZh: 教你在日落後的晴朗夜空中，辨認火星、木星和金星等明亮的行星。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Science & Technology

sentences.text: Seeing the brightest planets is easy.
sentences.zh: 要看到最亮的那幾顆行星其實很容易。

sentences.text: Go outside on a clear night after sunset.
sentences.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，日落之後走到戶外就行了。

sentences.text: The planets will shine brighter than the stars.
sentences.zh: 這些行星會比恆星還要亮。

sentences.text: Mars is a bright reddish-orange light, appearing high in the constellation Gemini.
sentences.zh: 火星是一顆明亮的橘紅色光點，高掛在雙子座的位置。

sentences.text: Jupiter is very bright, and a little lower than Mars, toward the constellation Taurus.
sentences.zh: 木星非常亮，位置比火星稍微低一點，靠近金牛座。

sentences.text: Venus, in the constellation of Pisces, is the brightest natural object in the sky, besides the sun and moon.
sentences.zh: 位在雙魚座的金星，是天空中除了太陽和月亮以外最亮的自然天體。

sentences.text: There are many stargazing apps available that can help identify the planets and bright stars.
sentences.zh: 現在有很多觀星 App 可以幫你辨認行星和亮星。

sentences.text: The planets will slowly move lower and lower in the west throughout the spring.
sentences.zh: 整個春天，這些行星會在西邊的天空慢慢愈降愈低。
